title: Design Day #13 — Automobile Design
description:
The theme for November's 2013's Design Day is:

AUTOMOBILE DESIGN

The agenda includes:
1. A Story: By an experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of a career in Design.

2. Tutorial/Skill Building Session: By an experienced Designer to teach us something new.

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 2 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people. We will have markers, sketchpens and chart papers for your use.

This event is charged at 100/- INR per person at the start of Design Day, and is non-refundable. This event is strictly for designers. Its fine if you are a beginner and want to learn.

Cheers,

Amit/Kavita/Aashish
